roads.name: Rattlesnake Road
words: Properly twisty: 18 curves in 3.5 miles, about 5 a mile.
From 4,351 to 4,712 ft, with 532 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.68 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.

roads.name: Forest Road 17
words: Sweeping and steady: 22 curves in 5.0 miles.
The mile at the west end is tamer.
About 1.9 miles in the middle are tamer.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 4,565 to 5,449 ft, with 1,589 ft of up and down along the way.
